_what: The steps of making a 3D object, in order. run.py and the page read this list.

steps.what: One clean reference image (GPT Image 2.5 on the Higgsfield connector), a real photo attached when one exists; people come from their character sheet.
Image → 3D on the Higgsfield connector (default); --local runs make3d, free, for background props
The house finish from definitions/finish.json (satin), centred, colours kept.
A Blender still; Claude looks at it next to the reference before it counts.
A small copy the artifact page can spin.
A row in <project>/3d/catalogue.json with the prompt, cost and files.
